# Allowlist for scripts/check-sensitive-data.sh — one extended regex per line.
#
# A finding whose full "file:line:content" record matches ANY regex below is
# suppressed. Every entry MUST carry a justification comment directly above
# it and should be as narrow as possible (anchor on the file path).
#
# Example:
#   # docs/foo.md quotes RFC 3849 IPv6 documentation samples
#   ^docs/foo\.md:.*2001:db8
